messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: hosted-api-prod p99 latency > 20s for 10m, queue length growing on us-west GPU pool. alerts: queue_size=8200, p95=3.2s, p99=18.6s :rotating_light:
alex (oncall): ack. joining call. grabbing logs + recent autoscaler events.
sasha: i'm on runway for infra scaling, pinging quota team in parallel. any noisy keys identified yet?
jordan: saw a huge burst from a third-party client id: api_key=key_7f3c; ~1.2M reqs in last 5m, mostly long-context generations.
maria: confirming errors: 504s at gateway for some requests, timeouts lower down at runtime. customers complaining via support.
alex (oncall): immediate mitigation plan: 1) enable model fallbacks to smaller quantized variant for hosted tier, 2) enable request shedding for >2M tokens/min customers, 3) open temporary rate limit for the offending key. implementing now.
alex (oncall): /infra autoscaler status us-west-gpu-pool --recent 30m
infra-bot: autoscaler(us-west-gpu-pool): desired=40, current=18, pending=0, failed_scale_attempts=3, last_failure=2026-03-15T02:03:12Z (quotaExceeded)
sasha: autoscaler failing due to cloud quota, asking cloud-quotas to lift soft cap. trying manual hot-add of 6 instances from reserved pool.
jordan: rolling fallback: route 30% of new requests to model:redwood-small-quant to reduce per-request GPU time. patching routing rule now.
maria: applying rate limit: /ratelimit set key_7f3c 100req/s  -> confirmed applied at edge (edge-proxy-12).
alex (oncall): also enabling prefix caching for identical prompt patterns; enabling KV cache warmup where possible.
alex (oncall): here's a snippet of the most recent queue snapshot: ```
TIME     queue_len  inflight  avg_exec_ms
02:17:00  8200       3400      1120
02:18:00  9100       3800      1350
02:19:00 10240       4200      1820
```
sasha: manual hot-add succeeded: +6 gpus from reserved, now current=24. starting gradual ramp to avoid cold-start thundering.
jordan: routing change pushed. initial telemetry shows p95 dropping from 3.2s -> 1.8s for routed traffic. p99 still high for large contexts.
maria: support note: we have 14 customers reporting 30s+ timeouts. two are paying enterprise with SLA. escalating to CSM.
alex (oncall): further mitigation: enable aggressive evictions for very long-running requests ( > 45s ) and return 429 to clients flagged as abusive. applying eviction policy now.
infra-bot: eviction-policy applied: max_execution_ms=45000, eviction_score_threshold=0.85
sasha: quota team responded: can lift GPU soft cap to allow autoscaler ops after 10m; they need final approval. can someone authorise? @alex
alex (oncall): approved. cloud-quotas increased. autoscaler will retry.
infra-bot: autoscaler retry: scaling to desired=48 started. expected nodes_ready ~ 6-9m.
jordan: observed a secondary effect: fallback model reduces quality for some callers; enabling a temporary explainable response header so CSMs can communicate. adding header `x-rw-fallback=redwood-small-quant` for routed traffic.
maria: publishing status update to status.redwood: "Degraded - Hosted API high latency due to traffic spike affecting GPU autoscaler; mitigation in progress (rate limits, fallbacks, manual scale)."
alex (oncall): any chance this is attack traffic? rate patterns look programmatic but could be legitimate customer with bad loop. logging request patterns and referer headers.
jordan: pattern shows same prompt template repeated with different inputs -> looks like heavy automated generation. flagging as abusive for enforcement team.
maria: CSM on-call notified for the two SLA customers, outreach templates ready.
sasha: nodes coming up: +10 GPUs online. current pool=34. queue dropping: 10240 -> 4200 in 6m. good sign.
alex (oncall): telemetry: p95 now 1.2s, p99 4.8s overall. timeouts decreasing.
jordan: keeping rate limit on offending key until traffic normalizes. will collaborate with customer to adjust.
maria: Impact summary for post-incident note: - window: ~02:10-03:05 UTC - affected: hosted API customers experiencing increased p99 and some 504s - severity: P1 (enterprise SLA risk) - mitigation: manual scale, rate-limit, fallback model routing, eviction policy - customer-facing actions: CSM emails, status updates, crediting small usage refund proposed.
alex (oncall): handing off to night-shift oncall @sasha for monitoring and post-incident followup. sasha, pls own postmortem + timeline and tag infra + product for fixes.
sasha: taking handoff. will keep watching for 30m then create postmortem draft. owners: sasha (lead), jordan (runtime), maria (support), infra (quota).
alex (oncall): thanks team. please add any observed root causes or improvement ideas in the thread. quick wins: increase reserved capacity buffer, fail-open to cheaper models earlier, queue-shedding thresholds per-customer.
jordan: logs to attach for postmortem: /var/log/hosting/2026-03-15/us-west/queue-snapshot-0219.log and autoscaler events export at /tmp/autoscaler-1719999999.json
maria: saving support tickets list: TICKET-3421, TICKET-3422, TICKET-3427. prepping customer comms.
sasha: creating postmortem doc and linking to this thread. will include timeline, metrics, and proposed infra/product actions.
alex (oncall): closing active pager. monitoring continues. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: Latency returned to baseline, autoscaler stabilized. follow-up: postmortem required.
